$comment: Shared table for checkovFramework (junit-to-hdf): which <testsuite> names a Checkov framework. Read by both converters/junit-to-hdf/go/converter_test.go and typescript/converter.test.ts so the two implementations are asserted against one definition and cannot drift apart. A suite names a framework only when its name is '<framework> scan' AND its testcases carry Checkov's bracketed prefix; the value matches checkov-to-hdf's check_type.

cases.name: terraform suite with Checkov-prefixed cases
cases.testCaseName: [HIGH][CKV_AWS_16] Ensure that RDS instances have encryption enabled

cases.name: dockerfile suite
cases.testCaseName: [LOW][CKV_DOCKER_2] Ensure that HEALTHCHECK instructions have been added to container images

cases.name: sca suite with a CVE-shaped case
the scan suffix alone is not enough; the cases must be Checkov-shaped
a test class is not a framework
Checkov names its suites in lower case
